capabilities: convert PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument and iWork files into Markdown notes
extract text from scanned PDFs and images via OCR or a vision model
transcribe audio and video recordings with Whisper
generate titles, tags and summaries with a local LLM
queue ingests and auto-ingest files dropped into a watched folder
extras: Desktop only. Engines and models are downloaded on demand at pinned versions (Docling about 2 GB, speech add-on about 2 GB, chat models 2-6 GB each). No telemetry, account or paid tier; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian cannot search or index the contents of binary files like PDFs, scans, spreadsheets and audio recordings, so what is inside them stays invisible to search and AI tools.
